name: Multi-Agent Investment Platform
headline: Multi-Agent Investment Platform - AI Equity
short_description: The Multi-Agent-Investment-Platform is a cutting-edge equity research assistant that transforms natural-language inquiries into concise investment briefings. Utilizing multi-agent orchestration and real-time financial data, it generates analyst-quality reports in seconds.
author: 0xRustPro

sections.overview:
The Multi-Agent Investment Research Platform is a FastAPI-powered system that transforms investment questions into structured analyst reports. It orchestrates multiple specialized agents—routing, market data retrieval, sentiment analysis, and visualization—to synthesize real-time data from Yahoo Finance, SEC EDGAR filings, and curated news sources. The platform uses retrieval-augmented generation with ChromaDB to ground answers in vectorized financial filings and market context, while MongoDB stores 24-hour conversation history for multi-turn analysis. A bilingual React frontend supports English and Chinese queries, enabling equity researchers, portfolio managers, and individual investors to conduct faster due diligence and generate professional-grade briefings without manual report compilation.
Generating quick investment reports
Answering complex financial questions
Providing real-time market analysis
Creating personalized investment briefings
sections.usage:
```
Generate an investment briefing for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include key financial metrics, recent trends, competitive landscape, and potential risks. Use real-time data and provide a concise summary with actionable insights.
```
